source.title: 麻衣相法 (1925, 文明書局, 秦慎安校勘)

method: Second assistant visual inspection of original scanned PDF screenshots via original-PDF page render, NOT OCR and NOT a human sign-off; source pages zero-based 27 and 86, with neighbor-page context 83-88.

rechecked_target_phrases.specific_observation: The first right-hand verse column includes the mouth description 口角光明唇兩齊 followed by 兩頭略仰不; adjacent column immediately left begins 垂低. The cross-column boundary is therefore essential, and the earlier single-crop OCR 0/3 does not establish phrase absence.
rechecked_target_phrases.interpretation_limit: Only textual description of slightly raised corners; facial expression, illumination, position and full lip conditions are not automatically measured or satisfied.

rechecked_target_phrases.specific_observation: Prose text in the original scan contains 眼須要含藏不露 and surrounding eye-white/black discussion. Phrase does not mean the contemporary eye-openness metric equals the traditional concept.
Column contains 口須方大 and lip/mouth appearance context. Do not equate mouth width alone with complete historical mouth type.

next_evidence_gate: A real human independently checks original PDF page 86 rightmost two verses with diagram attribution, character order, and complete relevant conditions; signs an actual short ROI review. Then M16.13 and M16.14 private tools produce source-scoped inputs and official pinned Cangjie extractors can run without inventing human approval.
